dedupe_keys.name: epa risk management plan rmp information

description: Under Section 112(r) of the Clean Air Act, facilities that hold more than a threshold quantity of a listed toxic or flammable substance in a process must submit a Risk Management Plan to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and resubmit it every five years. Each plan covers a hazard assessment with the potential effects of an accidental release, a five-year accident history and worst-case and alternative release scenarios; a prevention programme; and an emergency response programme. The plans form a national record of chemical facilities, their hazardous inventories, modelled off-site consequences and past accidents. Access is restricted: the off-site consequence analysis parts can be viewed in Federal Reading Rooms, other RMP information is available on request or through Freedom of Information Act requests, and the Vulnerable Zone Indicator System tells a user whether an address could be affected by an accident at an RMP facility. The RMP Public Data Tool is offline while EPA evaluates changes proposed in the Common Sense Approach to Chemical Accident Prevention rulemaking (comments closed 11 May 2026). No licence applies to the restricted records. Caveats: no bulk public download exists at present. For simulation it is the reference for chemical facility accident scenarios, vulnerable zones and emergency planning. Related catalogue records include the EPA Facility Registry Service, the Toxics Release Inventory and the CSB investigations.
